1.consolidated_definition: Darse uno un verde; holgarse, divertirse. “Y acicalado y compuesto, —va marcando su varilla.” José Ma. Lomba, , p. 207.
1.en_consolidated_definition: To give oneself a green; to relax, have fun. "And, adorned and composed, —he marks his stick." José Ma. Lomba, p. 207.
